raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Qwen2-Audio and AudioFlamingo3 no longer materialize a dense `[B, 1, S, S]` key-padding mask. Fixes #62350.

## Claims

- `None` and `sdpa` (including one leading `paged|`) return bool `[B, 1, 1, S]`.
- Flash attention names, including the kernels-community names after one `paged|` strip, return long `[B, S]` with 1 on visible keys.
- Eager returns float `[B, 1, 1, S]` with 0 on visible keys and `-inf` on pad keys. An all-pad row is `-inf`.
- `paged|paged|sdpa`, `flex_attention`, and any other name raise.
- A flash row with no visible keys raises.
- No successful return has both of the last two dimensions equal to `S`.
- Length math is unchanged: Qwen2 still uses `(max_mel_seq_len - 2) // 2 + 1`, and AudioFlamingo3 still uses `(max_mel_seq_len - 1) // 2 + 1`.

## Validation

CPU tests of `broadcast_audio_key_padding_mask` passed, including SDPA of the compact bool mask against the old square `0/-inf` mask (max abs diff 0 on kept query rows).

`tests/models/multimodal/test_audio_encoder_masks.py` imports vLLM. This machine has torch 2.5.1 and cannot import current main, so pytest was not collected here. The helper was loaded directly and the same assertions were run. No Qwen2-Audio or AudioFlamingo3 GPU forward was run. MiniCPM-O still builds the dense mask; it is outside this issue.

## Details

Both encoders expanded a `[B, S]` padding mask into `[B, 1, S, S]` and wrote `-inf` into the pad keys. SDPA already broadcasts a `[B, 1, 1, S]` key mask, and the flash paths take a `[B, S]` mask. One helper serves both call sites so the dispatch stays in one place. Qwen2-Audio and AudioFlamingo3 do not share an encoder class.

The default implementation is `sdpa`, read from `audio_tower.config._attn_implementation`. The flash all-pad check is a host read and runs only on that error path.

AI assistance was used (Grok). This is a first-cut draft. A GPU forward of both models is still required before this leaves draft. #62469 is a separate patch and is not updated here.

---

@@ -0,0 +1,120 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+from vllm.model_executor.models.audio_padding_mask import (
+    broadcast_audio_key_padding_mask,
+)
+
+_FLASH_NAMES = (
+    "flash_attention_2",
+    "flash_attention_3",
+    "flash_attention_4",
+    "kernels-community/flash-attn2",
+    "kernels-community/vllm-flash-attn3",
+    "kernels-community/aiter-flash-attn",
+    "kernels-community/flash-attn4",
+    "paged|flash_attention_2",
+)
+
+
+def _keep() -> torch.Tensor:
+    return torch.tensor(
+        [
+            [True, True, True, False, False],
+            [True, False, False, False, False],
+        ]
+    )
+
+
+def test_sdpa_and_default_are_compact_bool():
+    keep = _keep()
+    for name in (None, "sdpa", "paged|sdpa"):
+        mask = broadcast_audio_key_padding_mask(
+            keep,
+            name,
+            dtype=torch.float32,
+            device=torch.device("cpu"),
+        )
+        assert mask.dtype == torch.bool
+        assert mask.shape == (2, 1, 1, 5)
+        assert torch.equal(mask, keep.view(2, 1, 1, 5))
+        assert mask.shape[-2] != mask.shape[-1]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", _FLASH_NAMES)
+def test_flash_names_are_long_key_mask(name: str):
+    mask = broadcast_audio_key_padding_mask(
+        _keep(),
+        name,
+        dtype=torch.float32,
+        device=torch.device("cpu"),
+    )
+    assert mask.dtype == torch.long
+    assert mask.shape == (2, 5)
+    assert torch.equal(mask, _keep().to(torch.long))
+
+
+def test_eager_uses_additive_mask_and_all_pad_row_is_neg_inf():
+    keep = _keep()
+    mask = broadcast_audio_key_padding_mask(
+        keep,
+        "eager",
+        dtype=torch.float32,
+        device=torch.device("cpu"),
+    )
+    assert mask.shape == (2, 1, 1, 5)
+    assert mask.dtype == torch.float32
+    assert torch.equal(mask[0, 0, 0, :3], torch.zeros(3))
+    assert torch.isneginf(mask[0, 0, 0, 3:]).all()
+
+    all_pad = torch.zeros(1, 4, dtype=torch.bool)
+    padded = broadcast_audio_key_padding_mask(
+        all_pad,
+        "eager",
+        dtype=torch.float32,
+        device=torch.device("cpu"),
+    )
+    assert padded.shape == (1, 1, 1, 4)
+    assert torch.isneginf(padded).all()
+
+
+def test_flash_rejects_an_all_pad_row():
+    keep = torch.tensor([[True, False], [False, False]])
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="all-pad"):
+        broadcast_audio_key_padding_mask(
+            keep,
+            "flash_attention_2",
+            dtype=torch.float32,
+            device=torch.device("cpu"),
+        )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", ["paged|paged|sdpa", "flex_attention", "unknown"])
+def test_unsupported_names_raise(name: str):
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="unsupported audio attention"):
+        broadcast_audio_key_padding_mask(
+            _keep(),
+            name,
+            dtype=torch.float32,
+            device=torch.device("cpu"),
+        )
+
+
+def test_compact_sdpa_matches_square_mask_on_kept_rows():
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    query = torch.randn(2, 1, 5, 8)
+    key = torch.randn(2, 1, 5, 8)
+    value = torch.randn(2, 1, 5, 8)
+    keep = _keep()
+    square = torch.zeros(2, 1, 5, 5)
+    square.masked_fill_(~keep.view(2, 1, 1, 5), float("-inf"))
+    compact = keep.view(2, 1, 1, 5)
+    square_out = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(query, key, value, attn_mask=square)
+    compact_out = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(query, key, value, attn_mask=compact)
+    kept_rows = keep.view(2, 1, 5, 1).expand_as(square_out)
+    delta = torch.abs(square_out - compact_out)[kept_rows]
+    assert torch.max(delta).item() == 0

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+
+import torch
+
+_FLASH_NAMES = (
+    "flash_attention_2",
+    "flash_attention_3",
+    "flash_attention_4",
+    "kernels-community/flash-attn2",
+    "kernels-community/vllm-flash-attn3",
+    "kernels-community/aiter-flash-attn",
+    "kernels-community/flash-attn4",
+)
+
+
+def broadcast_audio_key_padding_mask(
+    keep: torch.Tensor,
+    attn_implementation: str | None,
+    *,
+    dtype: torch.dtype,
+    device: torch.device,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Key-padding mask with a singleton query axis.
+
+    ``keep`` is bool ``[B, S]`` with True on visible keys. ``None`` and
+    ``sdpa`` return bool ``[B, 1, 1, S]``. Flash names return long ``[B, S]``
+    with 1 on visible keys. Eager returns float ``[B, 1, 1, S]`` with 0 on
+    visible keys and ``-inf`` on pad keys.
+    """
+    if keep.ndim != 2 or keep.dtype != torch.bool:
+        raise ValueError("keep must be a bool tensor of shape [batch, time]")
+
+    name = "sdpa" if attn_implementation is None else attn_implementation
+    if name.startswith("paged|"):
+        name = name.removeprefix("paged|")
+
+    batch, seq_len = keep.shape
+    if name == "sdpa":
+        return keep.to(device=device).view(batch, 1, 1, seq_len)
+    if name in _FLASH_NAMES or "flash" in name:
+        if (keep.sum(dim=-1) == 0).any():
+            raise ValueError("flash attention rejects an all-pad audio row")
+        return keep.to(dtype=torch.long, device=device)
+    if name == "eager":
+        keep_on_device = keep.to(device=device)
+        mask = torch.zeros((batch, 1, 1, seq_len), dtype=dtype, device=device)
+        mask.masked_fill_(~keep_on_device.view(batch, 1, 1, seq_len), float("-inf"))
+        return mask
+    raise ValueError(
+        f"unsupported audio attention implementation {attn_implementation!r}"
+    )
